description: This file defines interfaces and functions for network packet capture support in Zephyr OS, including setup, cleanup, enable/disable, and packet sending functionalities.

methods.name: net_capture_setup
methods.description: Sets up network packet capturing support, configuring tunnel addresses and returning a capture device.

methods.name: net_capture_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up network packet capturing resources.

methods.name: net_capture_enable
methods.description: Enables network packet capturing on a device and interface.

methods.name: net_capture_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if network packet capture is enabled.

methods.name: net_capture_disable
methods.description: Disables network packet capturing on a device.

methods.name: net_capture_pkt
methods.description: Callback to determine if a packet needs to be captured.

methods.name: net_capture_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all capture devices to retrieve information.
